Welcome to Dr. Vikas Sharma Vet Channel

Hello Everyone,

I am Dr. Vikas Sharma (B.V.Sc & A.H., MVC - TANUVAS, Chennai), a practicing veterinarian dedicated to educating pet parents and animal lovers.

This channel provides reliable information on:

• Dog & Cat Health Care
• Vaccination & Deworming
• Pet Nutrition & Feeding
• Disease Diagnosis & Treatment
• Pet Behavior & Training
• Puppy Care & Growth
• Pregnancy & Breeding Management
• Veterinary Procedures
• Emergency Pet Care
• Farm & Companion Animal Health

Our goal is to promote responsible pet ownership and improve animal welfare through practical veterinary knowledge.

Disclaimer:
This channel is for educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified veterinarian before giving any medication or treatment to your pet.

Subscribe for pet care tips, dog health advice, veterinary education, disease management, and clinical veterinary demonstrations.

Dr. Vikas Sharma
B.V.Sc & A.H. | MVC (TANUVAS, Chennai)
